notes: CANONICAL FILE written by the consumer-confidence-2027-06-29 initial-research lane (2026-09-06) after reading the one prior proposal, proposals/consumer-confidence-2027-06-29.from-consumer-confidence-2027-05-25.json, which is now inert. THE CHAIN'S SHARPEST SEP GEOMETRY, quantified rather than asserted: per the Fed's posted calendar (federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, fetched 2026-09-06 HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes) the June 2027 projections meeting is 06-08/09*, the EARLIEST June FOMC in the 2021-2027 record and 20 days before this print against a modal 13. Using June's OWN sourced cut-off lags (6/7/6 days: 2022-06-22, 2023-06-20, 2024-06-19 -- the SHORTEST in the chain, not the ~8 the proposal borrowed from May), the 2027 panel fields roughly 06-06 -> 06-22/23, which puts 13 of its 17 days after the dot plot: 76% against 35% in five of the six tape years and 0% in 2025. The proposal's strict claim -- that the window OPENS after the release -- is refuted (it opens two to three days before the decision, which lands inside it); the substance holds at 2.2x the modal share. THE TRANSMISSION CHANNEL CANNOT BE TESTED FROM THE TAPE and is registered as a content-level forward test instead: clean CB days split by post-decision panel share run 0 of 9 (n=29 vs 22) and split by SEP-vs-non-SEP prior decision run 0 of 9 (n=28 vs 23). THE FINDING banked in docs/research/events/consumer-confidence-2027-06-29.md is structural and applies to this whole calendar: QUARTER-END IS A REAL REGIME AND MONTH-END IS NOT. The last four sessions of a quarter-end month run 6 of 9 narrower against all non-month-end sessions (XRT p=0.0011, XLF 0.0064, QQQ 0.0125, SPY 0.0179, XLY 0.0254, AMZN 0.0295; n=96 vs 1,167) and 5 of 9 against the last four sessions of an ORDINARY month (AMZN 0.0057, XRT 0.0224, XLF 0.0261, SPY 0.0410, QQQ 0.0433), while ordinary month-end against non-month-end is 0 of 9. 2027-06-29 sits one session before quarter end, inside that window -- the first print in this chain placed in a MEASURED regime rather than a null one. It also confounds the 05-25 sibling's December redirect: December's 7-of-9 last-5-vs-earlier signature drops to 0 of 9 once the quarter-end sessions are removed (n=6), while March's holds at 4 of 9, so the right control for the 03-30 week-level rule is quarter-end-vs-ordinary-month-end, not position-in-month. And June is not a flat month and not a June effect -- Jun+Jul+Aug vs the rest of the year is 9 of 9 narrower (VIX and SPY p<0.0001) while June vs Jul+Aug is 2 of 9, so June's month-level 1-of-9 is the summer block leaking through. The print day itself is null on every control (0 of 9 vs other June, other late-June, and all sessions) and its +0.582% median close-to-close, 5 of 6 up, is declined for multiple comparisons at p=0.29-0.45. Adjacency: fomc-minutes-2027-06-30 lands the very NEXT session (the Fed's own three-week convention; 42 of the 45 minutes dates listed on that page are exactly 21 days after the decision, the three exceptions all holiday-shifted in Nov/Dec) -- the first CB print in this chain with a tracked event on the following day.
